dedupeText: 90s eurodance album aesthetic eurodance 90s aesthetic chrome typography gradient background high contrast portrait futuristic retro subject centered in the lower two thirds of the frame header elements contained within a horizontal band at the top vertical graphic element on the right edge balancing the top left logo high key white negative space surrounding the subject combine a high key fashion portrait with a techno futurist header featuring chrome 3d typography and horizontal speed line textures

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a central figure against a stark white background, framed by a complex header featuring metallic, beveled typography and a horizontal gradient band with scan-line textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Header elements contained within a horizontal band at the top
Vertical graphic element on the right edge balancing the top-left logo
High-key white negative space surrounding the subject
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome finish on primary text
Horizontal scan-line or 'speed line' texture in the header
Warm, golden-toned skin lighting against a cool-toned header

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, crouching figure occupying the bottom 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The metallic logo/text block at the top left and center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the heavy metallic text, moves down the subject's gaze, and is contained by the vertical bar on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space around the subject to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-key contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and warm browns in the subject's clothing and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan, lavender, and mint green gradients in the header graphics.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) overall with localized high saturation in the header gradients.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muddy midtones in the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif and wide italic sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text features heavy 3D beveling and drop shadows
Secondary text is placed inside a rounded pill-shaped container
Letters have a metallic, airbrushed chrome texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower-case 'c' and 'l' are tightly kerned with overlapping shadows
Italicized secondary text for a sense of speed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display face paired with a wide, clean italicized sans-serif for a 'techno' feel.
graphicDevices: Vertical bar with digital noise texture
Circular logo emblem with concentric rings

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D chrome effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a woman in black leather clothing, crouching on a pure white background. Add a horizontal band at the top with a cyan-to-lavender gradient and thin horizontal scan-lines. Include a vertical bar on the far right with a digital glitch texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, beveled chrome-textured sans-serif title across the top band. Below it, add a pill-shaped mint-green container with wide, italicized black text.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text metallic and 3D?
Is the background pure white around the subject?
Does the header contain horizontal scan-line textures?
Is the subject's lighting warm and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Width of the right-side vertical graphic
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the 3D text
Ensure the white background is blown out and seamless
Verify the horizontal scan-lines are subtle but visible
Confirm the color palette remains within the 90s Eurodance spectrum
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key fashion portrait with a 'techno-futurist' header featuring chrome 3D typography and horizontal speed-line textures.
